nodes.label: Tomato Disease Detection Result Screen
nodes.description: UI design screenshot of the tomato disease detection result screen from the Smart Plant Disease app. Shows AI/ML model output after analyzing a tomato leaf image. Disease detected: Tomato Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) with high confidence (~94%). Features: back arrow navigation, detection result card, confidence progress bar, analyzed tomato leaf thumbnail showing dark brown/black lesions and water-soaked patches, disease description section, and treatment recommendations (remove infected parts, apply copper-based fungicide, improve air circulation, avoid overhead watering). Card-based scrollable layout with orange/red disease severity indicators.

edges.note: The detection result screen shows analysis of a tomato leaf (tomat) for disease classification
